visualCharacteristics.purpose: Thin full-width strip of activity words scrolling horizontally in an infinite loop
visualCharacteristics.layout: Single-line marquee between top and bottom rules; items separated by dots
visualCharacteristics.description: Horizontally auto-scrolling uppercase activity words separated by orange dots. Pauses on hover/focus; static and scrollable when the user prefers reduced motion.

contentPattern.structure: one row per item, one text cell (Cards no-images model): e.g. Climbing, Kayaking, Cycling, Desert, Photography, Hiking, Winter, Surfing, Expedition, Wild Swimming
contentPattern.notes: Enter each item once; the block duplicates the list (hidden from assistive technology) for the seamless loop. Only text is kept; empty rows are ignored and extra cells in a row are joined.

usage: Activity Ticker strip on the WKND Adventures homepage.
reuseGuidance: Use for decorative scrolling keyword or category strips. Not for content users must read or interact with.
